instruction:
Solve the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) with 28 customers and 1 depot (node 0). Each customer node has a demand. All vehicles have the same capacity 108. You must assign each customer to exactly one route and ensure that the sum of demands on each route does not exceed the vehicle capacity. Minimize the total distance traveled.

The input includes city coordinates, the 2 nearest neighbors for each city, and their respective distances. Provide the solution in the following format:
1. A list of routes, each route as an ordered list of visited nodes (start/end at the depot).
2. Objective: The total distance of all routes.
